description: This Python source file defines a payment service module for a food delivery backend, including classes, configuration, and functions for creating and confirming stubbed payment intents using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy. It handles order validation, payment state management, and simulates payment confirmation logic.

classes.name: PaymentsConfig
classes.description: A dataclass representing configuration settings for payment providers, currently minimal and intended for future expansion when integrating with Stripe or other providers.

methods.name: PaymentsConfig _get_payments_config()
methods.description: Loads payment provider configuration, defaulting to 'stub' or 'stripe' based on environment variables.

methods.name: str _fake_client_secret(order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic fake client secret string for an order, used in stub payment flows.

methods.name: Order _get_order_or_404(session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches an order by ID from the database or raises a 404 HTTP exception if not found.

methods.name: Payment|None _get_payment(session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves a payment record for a given order ID, or None if not found.

methods.name: tuple[str,int,str] create_payment_intent_stub( session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID, amount_cents: int, )
methods.description: Creates a placeholder payment intent for an order, validating order status and total, and storing a payment record with 'pending' status.

methods.name: Order confirm_payment_stub( session: AsyncSession, order_id: UUID, client_secret: str, )
methods.description: Simulates confirmation of a payment by validating client secret, updating order and payment statuses, and handling idempotency.
